news.title: John Deere acquires Orchard Robotics to move deeper into AI agriculture
news.summary: John Deere bought Orchard Robotics, the San Francisco crop-intelligence startup Charlie Wu founded in 2022 that operates as Orchard AI. Its FruitScope cameras ride on farm vehicles to count and size the fruit on every tree; terms weren't disclosed.

news.title: Palo Alto Networks bets $4.5B on AI startup Applied Compute as earnings top forecasts
news.summary: Palo Alto Networks agreed to buy Applied Compute, the model post-training and inference startup Yash Patil co-founded in 2025, in an all-stock deal worth $4.5B. It comes weeks after a round at $3.25B; the deal is expected to close in Palo Alto's fiscal third quarter, when Patil becomes its Co-Chief AI Officer.

news.title: Former DOGE staffers say they just hacked Anthropic in less than 12 hours
news.summary: Cathedral, the AI cybersecurity startup Luke Farritor co-founded with other former DOGE staffers, says it reached Anthropic’s internal data and Slack messages in under 12 hours through flaws in third-party business software. Anthropic, which invites outside security testing, confirmed access to a limited set of systems and has since closed it off.
